_doc: Generic open-wheel car built to the 2026 technical regulations. No team identity. Real regulation values carry a 'source'; everything else is engineering estimate/calibration (see DECISIONS.md, 'Car physics').
name: 2026 Regulation Car

mass.minimumSource: 2026 regs: minimum mass 768 kg including driver, excluding fuel (Mercedes Blog / f1technical.net quoting the regulation); axle minimums 44 % / 54 %
mass.estimateNote: CG height and yaw inertia: engineering estimates for a 3.4 m wheelbase single-seater

fuel.source: 2026 PU regs: fuel energy flow limited (3000 MJ/h, verify) with ~70 kg race fuel (reports), 100 % sustainable fuel

dimensions.source: 2026 regs: max wheelbase 3400 mm, max width 1900 mm (Mercedes W17 spec, Williams explainer); tracks/length estimated

wheels.source: 18-inch wheels retained; 2026 tyres 25 mm narrower front, 30 mm narrower rear (FIA 2024 announcement as reported); diameter ~710 mm (estimate)

tyreModel.source: Magic-Formula style combined-slip model; parameters are calibration values (peak slip angle ~6-7 deg typical for racing slicks)

aero.source: Calibrated to the 2026 Spa pace reference: ~30 % less downforce and ~50 % less drag in Straight mode than corner configuration (The Race, Silverstone 2026 explainers); absolute ClA/CdA tuned to lap time and top speed in data/reference/spa-2026-pace.json

steering.source: estimate; enough lock for La Source

brakes.source: estimate, sized to lock wheels at low speed and reach the grip limit at high speed; rear blended with MGU-K regeneration (brake-by-wire)

drivetrain.source: 8-speed gearbox required by regulation; ratios chosen for ~355 km/h at 11.8k rpm in 8th; shift times typical of seamless-shift units

ice.source: ~400 kW class turbo V6 limited by fuel energy flow (2026 PU regs: ICE output cut from ~550-560 kW); curve shape estimated

mguk.source: 2026 PU regs: MGU-K up to 350 kW (Honda / Williams explainers)

powerUnitParams.energyPresetsSource: Strategy calibration: deploy out of corners, harvest at full throttle above ~290 km/h ('superclipping', The Race 2026 explainer); matches the flat speed trace on Kemmel in 2026 Spa qualifying telemetry

systems._doc: Derived at load time from the modules; listed here for readers.
